pages.title: Oriental Stegodon
pages.text: $(o)Stegodon orientalis$() was an elephant-like proboscidean of the forests of southern China, Southeast Asia, Taiwan and Japan during the Middle and Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It was about the size of an Asian elephant, with long tusks that curved gently upward and grew so close together that its trunk probably rested on top of them.$(br2)It shared its forests with giant pandas and tapirs, and survived in China until at least 20,000 years ago.
